root_cause: Mastercard credit transactions suffered fee downgrades due to missing Level 2/3 commercial transaction data.
diagnosis: A total of 7 commercial Mastercard credit transactions experienced fee downgrades resulting in an overcharge exposure of Rs 519.76. Note that this comparison relies on an illustrative modeled benchmark.
action_rationale: Providing Level 2 and Level 3 transaction data ensures commercial cards qualify for lower interchange rates and prevents costly downgrades.
